## About
Local Plumbing & Sewer handles plumbing and sewer work for homes and businesses. That covers a leaking water heater, a clogged drain, a sewer line that needs repair, or water lines frozen in the cold.
We have a certified master plumber on staff, and we warranty our work.
Customers often mention Matt by name. One reviewer had him clear bathroom clogs in an older Lakeview single-family home. We're rated 5 on Google from 77 reviews.

## Services
- Water heaters: Help when your water heater is leaking or needs attention.
- Drain cleaning: Clogged sinks, tubs, showers, floor drains and laundry drains, plus main sewer cleaning.
- Sewer line camera inspections: A camera look inside your sewer line to find the problem before digging.
- Sewer line repair: Repair of damaged sewer lines, and replacement when repair isn't enough.
- Flood control installation: Flood control systems installed, inspected and repaired.
- RPZ valve testing: Testing, repair, replacement and installation of RPZ valves.
- Water leak detection: Tracking down hidden leaks in your water lines.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve customers in the northwest suburbs, the Chicagoland area and other surrounding areas.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, and closed on Sunday.

Q: Do you work for businesses?
A: Yes. A reviewer who had Matt out to their business said they would have him back again.
